name: Sweet Peach Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Sweet Peach is an indica dominant hybrid that all fans of peach will instantly love. This strain perfectly captures the aroma and taste of biting into a sweet, ripe peach balanced on a bed of floral and fruity aromatics — with a touch of peach candy! Its dominant terpenes include D-Limonene, Linalool, and Geraniol.
